original.target_description: Verified Raley, Kim and Daniels (2012), NLSY97 study of fertility expectations, college enrollment and persistence; multiple enrollment RRR and dropout OR models, without a uniquely identified target test.

replication.target_description: Verified Méndez Chacón SCORE replication 65o96 of the Raley study; five claim evaluations spanning enrollment models and a dropout interaction, without a supplied effect-to-claim mapping.

notes: Both primary works acquired and titles/reference verified. No neutral effect description, study identifier, outcome, predictor, model or claim ID was supplied. Replication report evaluates five separate focal claims; no mapping from this audit ID to those claims is provided. Audit ID order was not used to infer a mapping. No effect-level authors’ verdict can be assigned confidently. OR metric alone does not identify the original table/model/row. Report trace 5 is a potential OR claim, but assigning it to this audit ID would require an unsupported mapping.
